## Context / Problem
The infra/compose cohort contains audited comments or docstrings that obscure current behavior with repetition, obvious narration, duplicated explanation, or historical detail. The audit is pinned to `9e65567b79ffe872534c3c656ade7b34340d8192`.

## Approach
Edit explanatory text only in this directory/subsystem cohort. Condense it to current, non-obvious rationale and constraints; retain every file-specific preserve item and consumer contract below. Grouping adjacent files from one subsystem keeps the change reviewable in one session and permits one coherent verification pass without changing executable behavior.

## Scope
- `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml:1-24,81-136,160-234,250-322,332-408,431-548,570-574` — Preserve shutdown/drain bounds, persistent stores, credential/file mounts, Bedrock region variables, scratch-volume admission markers, loopback/proxy trust boundary, clone/write behavior, soft versus fail-closed secrets, non-destructive external volumes. Consumer: Docker Compose, deployment scripts, security/operators.
- `infra/compose/Dockerfile.gerrit:1-17,34-42` — Preserve image purpose, required packages, exact g2p commit pin and why PyPI is unsuitable. Consumer: Docker builders/operators.
- `infra/compose/Dockerfile.mcp:1-15,33-45,73-94,113-151` — Preserve locked build, runtime dependency boundary, non-root/runtime paths, real entrypoint requirement. Consumer: Docker builders/MCP operators.
- `infra/compose/Dockerfile.opcert:1-13,33-41` — Preserve trusted gate image, agents dependency, non-root/runtime contract. Consumer: Docker builders/op-cert operators.
- `infra/compose/Dockerfile.reviewbot:1-23,43-116,122-147` — Preserve runtime Git/scanner requirements, lock-based install, store helper, entrypoint and writable-path constraints. Consumer: Docker builders/review-bot operators.
- `infra/compose/gerrit.config:1-10,70-77,99-121` — Preserve deployment location, OAuth boot prerequisites, topic-global collision warning, outbound mail disabled explicitly and restart required. Consumer: Gerrit/operators.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every listed location contains only current, non-obvious rationale or constraints after remediation; verified by reviewing the final diff against every Scope row.
- [ ] Every preserve item in Scope remains explicit and accurate; verified by the row-by-row completion comment.
- [ ] Every consumer contract in Scope remains explicit and accurate; verified by the row-by-row completion comment.
- [ ] No executable behavior changes; verified by inspecting the final diff and running the command under Verification.
- [ ] No test assertion changes; verified by inspecting the final diff.

## Verification
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint`

The row-by-row diff review is authoritative for prose quality; the hygiene guard detects only its narrow deterministic history-token rule.
